C1004.title: Tencent Game Security Center Bans Player for Match-Fixing Behavior
C1004.summary: On May 29, 2026, Tencent Game Security Center confirmed a player engaged in match-fixing behavior and issued a 180-day account suspension along with leaderboard removal. The case demonstrates the system's strict enforcement against disruptive behavior in high-tier ranked matches through data analysis and violation history review.
